mentions.name: Kan
mentions.description: An offline Kanban system stored as files in a Git repository for tracking tasks and projects. AI agents can interact with it through the kan CLI, express which cards block what, and automatically pick up work with 'kan ready'.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://github.com/amterp/kan is an offline Kanban-as-files-in-your-Git-repo project I started near the beginning of the year and continue to evolve and work on. It's my main way to track tasks and projects, and these days I'm handing a ton of control of my kanban boards over to AI agents that interact with it thru the kan CLI, express which cards block what, etc, and they can pick up work automatically with 'kan ready'.
mentions.author: amterp
